---
title: "Teaching"
---

I am a certified [Carpentries](https://carpentries.org/) instructor and have created and taught workshops and courses on R, Python, statistics, data visualization, the Unix shell, and Git/GitHub for researchers — at GWU and at institutions across the U.S. and internationally.

## Courses & Workshops

- **2026** — Instructor, [Data Carpentry](https://datacarpentry.org/) Genomics workshop (University of Utah)
- **2017–2026** — Creator and Instructor, multiple workshop series at GWU: R for Data Analysis and Visualization, Python for Data Analysis, Statistical Inference in R, Data Visualization, Bash Shell for Researchers, Git/GitHub, and more
- **2025** — Instructor and Organizer, Data Carpentry Metagenomics workshop (Tel Aviv University)
- **2025** — Instructor and Organizer, Data Carpentry Genomics workshop (GWU)
- **2024** — Instructor and Organizer, Data Carpentry Genomics workshop (Weizmann Institute of Science, Israel) — the first Data Carpentry workshop held in Israel
- **2023** — Instructor and Organizer, Data Carpentry Metagenomics workshop (GWU)
- **2023** — Instructor, Data Carpentry Genomics workshop (Rutgers University)
- **2023** — Teaching Assistant, PUBH 6899, new 3-credit Data Visualization course (R, ggplot2, computational biology)
- **2022** — Instructor and Organizer, Data Carpentry Genomics workshop (GWU)
- **2022** — Instructor, workshops on Python for Data Analysis and R for Data Analysis; workshop series on Statistical Inference in R; Instructor, Python Camp
- **2021** — Adjunct Instructor and creator, PUBH 6851 *Introduction to R Programming in Public Health and Biomedical Research* (GWU)
- **2020** — Adjunct Instructor and creator, PUBH 6899 *Fundamentals of R for Biomedical and Public Health Researchers* (GWU)
- **2018** — Instructor, Software Carpentry (Bash Shell, Git, R), Carnegie Mellon University
- **1995** — Teaching Assistant, Decision Analysis, University of Virginia
- **1994** — Teaching Assistant, Introduction to Engineering, University of Virginia
- **1994** — Teaching Assistant, Data Structures and Algorithms, Johns Hopkins University Center for Talented Youth
